title: The Island Hook
specs: Opportunities to see sea lions, dolphins, whales, and other marine life
Visit Catalina Island with options for Avalon, Emerald Bay, Two Harbors, or Parsons Landing
Boat supports groups, parties, and special events with capacity for up to 12 guests when docked or moored

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Full kitchen (galley) with a refrigerator, freezer, microwave, stove top, with snacks and beverages. When you are out on the water the captain (or crew) is also your private chef! Enjoy lunch or BBQ dinner on the water. Enjoy fresh made ceviche from fish that you caught, or a lobster pulled out of Catalina with steak

includes: Boat equipped with paddle boards, floating dock, full galley with BBQ and griddle, DJ equipment, karaoke, lighting
gap: Prices not stated for any trips
blurb: Guests embark on ocean adventures including fishing, lobster trips, and visits to Catalina Island. Trips offer opportunities to see marine life, sunbathe, BBQ, and enjoy water toys. The boat is equipped for groups, parties, and special events with amenities like paddle boards, DJ equipment, and a full galley.
extraNote: 50% deposit due at booking, full payment due before departure · Cleaning fee $100 depending on overnight stay · Deckhand extra depending on length of trip
